lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in a regular grid posterior to the gill slits, forming vertical columns and horizontal rows. In the mid-lateral section, approximately four vertical columns are visible, each containing three to four distinct spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity align with the columns of circular spots, creating a lattice-like appearance where the spots act as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition along its longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
